🧙 The Legend of the Magical Potion

A very long time ago...

In a magical kingdom filled with castles, dragons, enchanted forests and mysterious caves, there lived a wise old wizard called Wizzy.

Wizzy was the guardian of the Magical Potion of Knowledge.

The potion helped children become clever, brave and confident.

But one day... the Magical Potion disappeared.

Nobody knows where it went.

Some believe it was hidden inside magical treasure chests.

Others believe it was scattered across enchanted worlds protected by puzzles, riddles and magical creatures.

🌟 Your Adventure

⭐ Every correct answer earns 5 Stars.

🎁 Every 20 questions earns a Treasure Chest.

🌍 Collect every Treasure Chest to unlock the next magical world.

🏆 Recover the Magical Potion and become the Academy's greatest explorer!
